scale.how: the 32'-0" overall dimension across the top measures 857.5 px, so 26.80 px per ft; the 29'-0" dimension down the left side measures 765 px, so 26.38 px per ft. The two disagree by 1.6 %. Every area in this key is computed with 26.80 px per ft.

tasks: Set the scale: box the 32'-0" dimension at the top from arrowhead tip to arrowhead tip (label: scale: 32'-0" dimension).
Box every room, porch and hall (label: room).

Careful: the sizes printed on this sheet do not agree with the drawing. The bedroom lettered 10' x 11' and the one lettered 11' x 11' are drawn in the same 10.4 ft wide column, and the BATH is lettered 5' x 7' but drawn 6.9 ft x 4.7 ft. The answer key is the area you measure off the drawing, not the lettered size; say in your report which rooms disagree and by how much.
